description: This file defines an interface for a listener in the Fineract project, specifically for actions to be taken after a batch job execution related to COB (Close of Business).

classes.name: FineractCOBAfterJobListener
classes.description: An interface defining callback methods to be invoked after a batch job completes, and to retrieve the job name.

methods.name: afterJob
methods.description: Callback method called after a batch job execution, providing the JobExecution details.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Method to retrieve the name of the job associated with this listener.
